decisions.decision: Created 21 new articles covering monetization, LATAM tallas, editorial, and content gaps
decisions.reasoning: GSC data showed LATAM traffic potential + gap analysis identified missing topics
decisions.lesson: Always verify duplicates first — 6 topics already existed and were skipped

decisions.decision: Configured AdSense + AliExpress + Amazon affiliate monetization
decisions.reasoning: Site had zero monetization despite 16 clicks/week traffic
decisions.outcome: 100% ad coverage (317/317 posts), 5 slug-specific CTAs, 8 category CTAs
decisions.lesson: type:'post' field is critical — missing it on 8 articles initially caused invisible ads

decisions.decision: Ran first health check — all systems nominal
decisions.reasoning: Post-deploy verification needed after major content + monetization changes
decisions.outcome: HTTP 200 on all pages, SSL valid until June, container healthy
decisions.lesson: Health check script works reliably for basic monitoring

decisions.decision: Established W13 baseline and proposed 3 content queue items
decisions.reasoning: First automated SEO run — need baseline before measuring improvement
decisions.outcome: Baseline saved, 3 actions proposed (CTR fix, GEO, content audit)
decisions.lesson: Ahrefs MCP tools don't work with current plan — need alternative GSC access

decisions.decision: Agent system v2 deployed: 13 agents with soul + 4-layer memory + structured protocols
decisions.reasoning: User feedback identified gaps: no orchestrator, no refresher, no link architect, no compliance, no CRO, no measurement. Added 7 new agents organized in 6 layers.
decisions.outcome: 13 soul files, 13 slash commands, 4 memory files, org chart with boundaries and overlap rules
decisions.lesson: Agent system needs governance layer (Diana) to prevent uncoordinated work. Protocols must be structured JSON, not free text.

decisions.decision: Optimized golden page: seoTitle 75→56 chars, seoDescription 195→145 chars, 0→8 internal links
decisions.reasoning: Title was truncated by Google at ~60 chars — the [Calculadora 2026] hook was invisible. Meta also truncated. Zero internal links meant the page was an isolated node losing link equity.
decisions.outcome: Title/meta now fully visible in SERP. 8 internal links to country pages, shoe converter, Shein guide, sujetador guide, buying guide.
decisions.lesson: Always check char count for seoTitle (≤60) and seoDescription (≤155). Google truncation kills CTR.
